# Brand logo sources

- `family-mart.svg`: square sign layout adapted for the map badge reference, using the original vector wordmark paths from [FamilyMart text logo 2007](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:FamilyMart_text_logo_2007.svg), sourced there from FamilyMart's shareholder report. Green and blue sign fields retain the existing square icon arrangement. Text-logo source is marked public domain; trademark ownership remains with FamilyMart.
- `seven-eleven.svg`: original SVG from the [7-Eleven official website](https://www.7-eleven.com/assets/img/header/7e-logo-color.svg). The [Commons source record](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:7-Eleven_logo_2021.svg) identifies Seven & I Holdings and marks it as a public-domain text logo. Trademark ownership remains with its owner.

Both SVGs contain vector paths rather than enlarged bitmap pixels. Their local paths are shared by map markers, the store directory and existing brand icon consumers through environment configuration.
